Development version: built automatically from the newest changes to Evochora and replaced with every new one, so it may contain errors. For regular use, take the newest release with a version number.

## Downloads

Choose the archive for your platform, unpack it, and start Evochora as the [Quick Start](https://github.com/evochora/evochora#quick-start) describes.

| Platform | Archive |
|---|---|
| Windows x64 | `evochora-latest-windows-x64.zip` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `evochora-latest-macos-aarch64.tar.gz` |
| Linux x64 | `evochora-latest-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Linux ARM64 | `evochora-latest-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` |

To run this version in Docker instead:

```
docker pull ghcr.io/evochora/evochora:latest
```
